lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 11-12 distinct vertical white lines traversing the torso. Spacing is broader on the anterior flank and decreases in width towards the posterior rump.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The first anterior line and the final two posterior lines are abbreviated, terminating before reaching the dorsal or ventral extremities of the torso mass.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of approximately 6-8 high-contrast white spots is visible on the lower haunch and upper hind limb.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three spots on the mid-thigh form a semi-linear horizontal alignment.

other_distinctive_markers: White transverse bands are visible on the anterior surface of the carpus and tarsus joints. A distinct white crescent is visible on the lower throat.
